name: Onii-chan wa Watashi-tachi no Omocha
original_name: お兄ちゃんは私たちのおもちゃ
source:
Big brother Takeya has been gone for a year. His father asks him to return home to care for his younger sisters while he and their mother are away on business. But being alone with his aggressive little sisters is too much! They want sex, they want to become his brides, they want his babies, and they won't listen to a word he says. If onii-chan doesn't want to have sex with his little sisters, they'll force him to!

It's not long before Takeya becomes their slave, their pet, their toy to play with.
translation:
竹谷哥哥已经离开一年了。他的父亲要求他在他和母亲出差期间回家照顾妹妹。但单独和他那些咄咄逼人的妹妹们在一起实在是太过分了！他们想要性，他们想要成为他的新娘，他们想要他的孩子，但他们不会听他说的任何一句话。如果哥哥不想和他的妹妹们发生性关系，他们就会强迫他！

没过多久，竹谷就成了他们的奴隶、他们的宠物、他们的玩具。
